body:
Triage (triage seat, session `session_01PCuhUdqwK7zkkxgtJHswTc`): graded into the decision inbox — whether `@objectstack/spec` carries `rows` on `markdown`/`html` authorable metadata is an acceptance-set expansion (human floor), and the card itself rules it "a spec question and not this repo's to answer alone". → `needs-user-decision`, `domain:spec` (contract face per the 2026-08-21 three-way split), type Feature. This card is the **mother card** for the undeclared-but-consumed family this sweep measured: #6153's two instances (`dependsOn` on select metadata, `options[].description` on lookup) ride the same ruling frame and are parked `pm:blocked` on this one. 四维分析如下(中文,业务视角):

<!-- os-decision-facets -->

**一句话问题**:富文本字段的行高(`rows`)在应用里真实生效,但按规则书写的作者写了它会被发布校验响亮拒绝 —— 功能在跑,合法作者却写不进去;同门的多行文本字段(textarea)早就正大光明声明了同一个键。

**选项 × 真实代价**:
- **A 声明它**:`MarkdownFieldMetadata`/`HtmlFieldMetadata` 加 `rows?: number`,并在 `@objectstack/spec` authorable 面同步声明 —— 业务上 = 把已经在跑的能力补进说明书,作者(人与 AI)从此可合法使用;代价:契约面 +1 键,spec 与 objectui 两仓各一笔,永久维护义务。
- **B 删掉读取**:widget 不再读 `rows`,行内编辑器固定高度 —— 业务上 = 收回一个没人承诺过的旁门,和「声明即强制」同向;代价:已有作者若在库里写了 `rows`(经 `as any` 生效)会静默失去行高,且同门 textarea 有此能力、富文本没有,产品面不对称。
- (家族卡 #6153 的两个键各自套同一框架裁:`dependsOn` 有已声明的 snake_case 兄弟 `depends_on`,大概率是 B/迁移拼写;`options[].description` 是真被搜索消费的行为,更像 A。)

**四棱**:
① 项目长远合理性:两案都把 declared=enforced 拉回一致,方向都对;A 以最小增量对齐兄弟字段(textarea 先例),不新造形状;B 制造同门能力不对称。
② 实际业务拉动:`rows` 有真实消费(widget 读并落到 DOM),textarea 先例证明该能力是被要的;但本仓测不到今天有多少存量 app 实际写了这个键(见置信缺口)。
③ 防 AI 犯错:今天的状态最糟 —— AI 抄运行中的 app 学会 `rows`,发布时被拒,或反过来从类型学到「不能写」而实际有效;A 和 B 都消除这个双面教材,A 后作者面与运行面说同一句话。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:+1 键是最小义务,且是「把既成事实入册」而非新能力;若倾向从紧,B 也成立,但要接受删行为的回归风险。
**推荐**:A(`rows` 补声明,对齐 textarea 先例),回退 B。低摩擦裁决:回 A/B;「A,但只 objectui 类型层、spec 面缓议」也可,自动落为 objectui 先行 + spec 卡另立。
**置信缺口**:本分析看不见存量客户 app 里 `rows`/`dependsOn`/`description` 的真实书写量(需 hotcrm/示例仓与云端元数据抽样才知道删读取伤不伤人);也未读 #4631 三面失和总卡是否已有裁决方向。

**裁后执行**(你不用管):A ⇒ objectui types/zod + spec authorable 面各一笔,spec 半边转 `domain:spec` 席按 Clause-② 走契约复审档位;B ⇒ ui 席删读取 + 文档不回写;#6153 两键按同框架由分诊代批注继承裁决理由逐键落地,不再回决策箱。

Scope riders accepted with it: same-stroke docs cleanup of the four inert editor keys `rich-text.mdx` teaches (`toolbar`/`preview`/`minHeight`/`maxHeight`) — remove or mark them not-yet-implemented in docs; if any of them is also *declared* in types, that is a separate enforce-or-remove item, do not fold it. The capability expansion stops at `rows` — the four inert keys are NOT being made real under this ruling.

State transition: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (label swap by triage; if the label still shows the old state, it is recorded rate-limit debt — this comment is the authoritative ruling record). Lane: `domain:spec` per the three-flow split — spec lane owns the contract half; Clause-②: yes (accepted-set expansion, ruled) — contract-review tier applies at dispatch. Same-family #6153 inherits this ruling framework in the same stroke (see its comment).
